text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The day of the Satsuki Sho. In the midst 
of heavy rain, all eyes in the crowd were 
focused on Mr. C.B.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Heading into the showdown, Katsuragi Ace 
was fired up like never before. Mr. C.B. 
remarked that it made her look forward to 
the race even more.
